name: the-cold-city
description: Build step for deployment: the game is one self-contained file, so 'building' is copying the single source of truth into the output directory as index.html. This is what stops the deployed site drifting from the repo — there is no second copy to keep in sync by hand.

scripts.prebuild: test ! -f pilgrim.html || { echo ''; echo 'BUILD STOPPED: a stray pilgrim.html is at the repo root.'; echo 'The game is built from pilgrim/web/pilgrim.html — the root copy will NOT deploy.'; echo 'Move your changes into pilgrim/web/pilgrim.html and delete the root file.'; echo ''; exit 1; }
